offering_description.value: Produces, packages and distributes nonalcoholic beverages under licensed brands to grocery, mass, convenience and foodservice customers in the southeastern and mid-Atlantic US. It bottles in its own plants and delivers through its own route-based network.

primary_products.value: carbonated soft drinks; bottled water; sports drinks; energy drinks; teas and juices

customer_segment.value: B2B: grocery and mass retailers, convenience stores, restaurants, schools and venues

end_markets.value: food and beverage retail; foodservice and hospitality; convenience; vending

revenue_model.value: product sales: beverages sold to retailers, foodservice outlets and distributors

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: bottles beverages from concentrate and syrup under franchise agreements, sold to retailers and foodservice; distributor: delivers finished beverages directly to store shelves, coolers and outlets

geography_served.value: US regional: Southeastern and mid-Atlantic states, including North Carolina, South Carolina, Virginia, Tennessee and West Virginia

specialization.value: related lines: carbonated soft drinks, water, sports and energy drinks, teas and juices

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct store delivery to grocery, convenience and foodservice accounts; own locations: company bottling plants and regional distribution centers; other: vending machines and cooler placements at customer locations

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: food safety and labeling rules from FDA and state agencies, plus environmental and packaging rules
